name: wordquest
description: Voice, motion and puzzle games for children aged 2-11. Ships to the web, Google Play and the App Store from one codebase.

scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.verify: node tools/check.mjs && node tools/check-robot.mjs && node tools/check-balance.mjs
scripts.test: node tools/check-styles.mjs && node tools/smoke.mjs && node tools/check-wiring.mjs && node tools/test-hub.mjs && node tools/test-slide.mjs && node tools/test-robot.mjs && node tools/test-balance.mjs && node tools/test-town.mjs
scripts.test:voice: node tools/test-mic-gate.mjs && node tools/test-mic-noise.mjs && node tools/test-tts.mjs && node tools/test-voice.mjs
